text: My son is 3 months old and has a temp of 38.6. Started yesterday with a runny nose that gets a bit blocked, lots of sneezing. He's wide awake right now, cooing at me and following the lamp with his eyes, and when he does nod off he wakes up easily. Breathing looks completely normal, I've watched him for a while. Not panicking, just know at his age a temperature is meant to be checked, so want to know the next step.
